description: The figure is a horizontal stacked bar chart illustrating, for several labeled criteria, the percentage split between two outcomes shown in the legend as “Matched” (dark blue) and “Not Matched” (light blue). The category axis is the vertical axis, listing six categories from top to bottom: No Hallucination, Oriented, Active, Self-aware, Rigorous, and Correct. The value axis is the horizontal axis labeled in percentages, shown on a linear scale from 0% to 100% with tick marks at regular 20% intervals (0%, 20%, 40%, 60%, 80%, 100%). Each category has one bar that spans the full 0–100% width and is subdivided into two stacked segments: for No Hallucination, the dark-blue Matched segment occupies nearly the entire bar with a small light-blue Not Matched segment labeled 1.67% at the right end; for Oriented, Matched is labeled 97.33% with Not Matched labeled 2.67%; for Active, Matched is labeled 97.00% with Not Matched labeled 3.00%; for Self-aware, Matched is labeled 94.00% with Not Matched labeled 6.00%; for Rigorous, Matched is labeled 95.33% with Not Matched labeled 4.67%; and for Correct, Matched is labeled 99.00% with Not Matched labeled 1.00%. The bars appear in the listed order rather than being explicitly sorted by value, and there is no additional visual emphasis beyond the color coding and the percentage annotations placed within or near the bar segments.
